Subject: Feedback on B2B Sales Visit to Small Business Branch

Dear [Manager's Name],

I wanted to provide you with some feedback on the recent B2B sales visit I conducted to the small business branch. During my visit, I discovered that the business was actually a branch and was given an email to contact the head office for further communication.

Overall, the visit went well and I was able to successfully engage with the branch manager and discuss the products and services we offer. However, I believe there is an opportunity to further expand our reach by reaching out to the head office and showcasing the benefits of our offerings to the broader organization.

I plan to follow up with the head office via email to introduce our company and schedule a meeting to discuss how we can help support their business goals. I will keep you updated on any progress and next steps.

Thank you for your support and guidance throughout this process. I appreciate the opportunity to represent our company in the field and look forward to continuing to drive sales and generate new business opportunities.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
